Subject: Revised schedule for the Margao substation upgrade

Dear Ms Fernandes,

Thank you for your note of 12 June. We have reviewed the revised drawings and can start work on 1 July, two weeks later than planned. The delay reflects the time needed to source two transformers from Pune.

The revised price is ₹4.2 crore, about 6 per cent above the original estimate. The increase comes from higher copper prices and an extra cable run that your team requested on 3 June. A breakdown by item is attached.

Please confirm the new start date by 20 June so that we can book the crane. If you would like to go through the figures, I am free on Thursday afternoon.

Regards,
Anil Kamat
Project Manager, Konkan Grid Services
